title: SS27 Men's Design and Production Innovations
summary: Body scanning and 3D sampling, product data ready for the EU Digital Product Passport, and SS27 production planned around new EU rules and the Lunar New Year.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Balenciaga used 3D body scans to build mannequins for its couture<sup>[1]</sup>.
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027; since 19 July 2026, large companies may not destroy certain unsold apparel; since 1 July 2026, a temporary €3 duty applies per item on consignments up to €150<sup>[2]</sup>.
- Brands are diversifying sourcing towards Vietnam, Bangladesh, India, Turkey and Morocco<sup>[2]</sup>.
- Lunar New Year falls on 6 February 2027; factories slow from late January<sup>[3]</sup>.

design_implications: - Develop first samples in 3D; record fibre, origin and care for every style.
commercial_implications: - Build buffer time around Lunar New Year; buy shallower in the EU.
